title: The Office - Presentation Series 3 - Making Comparisons

segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and today we've got another episode in our series about giving a presentation.
segments.zh: 我是凯瑟琳，今天我们带来了关于演示的系列中的又一集。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Today we're going to talk about some key elements of the topic that we're talking about.
segments.zh: 今天我们要聊聊这个话题的一些关键要素。

segments.en: We're talking about a laptop computer.
segments.zh: 我们说的是笔记本电脑。

segments.en: So we're going to give some more details and characteristics about the computer and what makes it so special.
segments.zh: 因此，我们将提供有关计算机的更多细节和特征以及它如此特别的原因。

segments.en: So let's take a listen to what Mr. Ford has to say about what makes this company's computers very special.
segments.zh: 因此，让我们来听听一下福特先生对这家公司的计算机的特别之处的看法。

segments.en: Now a key question you might ask yourself is what differentiates the new X420 line with our previous models and also of course with some of our competitors.
segments.zh: 现在，您可能会问自己的一个关键问题是，新 X420 系列与我们以前的型号以及与一些竞争对手相比有何不同。

segments.en: In other words, what makes the X420 stand out from all the others?
segments.zh: 换句话说，是什么让 X420 脱颖而出？

segments.en: This is a key question and it's something I'd like to explore in a little depth.
segments.zh: 这是一个关键问题，也是我想深入探讨的问题。

segments.en: Firstly the X420 has a range of USPs that really make it a cut above the rest.
segments.zh: 首先，X420 有一系列独特卖点，让它明显胜过同类产品。

segments.en: The first thing to mention is that the X420 is the first in a new generation of ultra-light laptop computers.
segments.zh: 首先要提到的是，X420是新一代超轻型笔记本电脑中的第一款。

segments.en: It is only two pounds which compares very favorably with all our key competitors.
segments.zh: 它只有两磅，与我们所有的主要竞争对手相比很有优势。

segments.en: In terms of computer performance, for such a light machine it's very powerful.
segments.zh: 在计算机性能方面，对于这样的轻型机器来说，它是非常强大的。

segments.en: Four gigabytes of RAM with an ultra-fast processor.
segments.zh: 4 GB RAM 超快处理器。

segments.en: The most advanced video and sound cards on the market are installed with a crystal clear 15 inch LCD display.
segments.zh: 它配备了市面上最先进的显卡和声卡，以及一块清晰通透的十五英寸液晶显示屏。

segments.en: The X420 really stands out as a next generation laptop.
segments.zh: X420作为下一代笔记本电脑确实脱颖而出。

segments.en: Compared with our previous X540 range it really is in a league of its own.
segments.zh: 和我们之前的 X540 系列相比，它完全不是一个级别的。

segments.en: Now if we go on to look at projected sales for the X420, we can see that sales revenue for 2010 is expected to hit at least $20 million.
segments.zh: 现在，如果我们继续查看 X420 的预计销售额，我们可以看到 2010 年的销售收入预计将达到至少 2000 万美元。

segments.en: Now this is really a conservative estimate.
segments.zh: 现在这确实是一个保守的估计。

segments.en: If our marketing campaign is successful, I'm confident that we could see a doubling of this figure at the very least.
segments.zh: 如果我们的营销活动成功，我相信我们至少可以看到这个数字的两倍。

segments.en: Now please bear in mind that this is only for the first year of production.
segments.zh: 现在请记住，这只是生产的第一年。

segments.en: I'm certain that in the coming three years the X420 will actually overtake all our existing products both in terms of sales and revenue.
segments.zh: 我敢肯定，在未来三年中，X420 实际上将在销售和收入方面超过我们所有现有的产品。

segments.en: Okay now let's move on to discuss our marketing concept and look more closely at our key competitors.
segments.zh: 好的，现在让我们继续讨论我们的营销理念，更仔细地看看我们的主要竞争对手。

segments.en: Alright we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So we obviously heard a lot of vocab here, a lot of interesting things regarding the computer.
segments.zh: 所以我们显然在这里听到了很多词汇，很多关于计算机的有趣事情。

segments.en: Why don't we take a look at some of the words that he used on language takeaway.
segments.zh: 我们为什么不看看他在语言要点上使用的一些单词。

segments.en: Language takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: So the first word that is pretty challenging is to differentiate.
segments.zh: 所以第一个非常具有挑战性的词是区分。

segments.en: It's a verb.
segments.zh: 这是一个动词。

segments.en: So Mr. Ford says, ask yourself what it is that differentiates this new computer line with other ones.
segments.zh: 所以福特先生说，问问自己，是什么让这个新电脑系列与其他电脑有所不同。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So to differentiate, that means what makes it different, what is so special about it, right?
segments.zh: 所以要区分，这意味着它与众不同，它有什么特别之处，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So you can ask a question like this.
segments.zh: 所以你可以问这样的问题。

segments.en: What differentiates Apple computers from other computers?
segments.zh: 苹果电脑与其他电脑的区别是什么？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So you're asking what makes it so different.
segments.zh: 所以你在问是什么让它如此不同。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So then he rephrases the question and he says, well in other words, what makes the X420 stand out from all the other computers?
segments.zh: 那么他重新表述了这个问题，他说，换句话说，是什么让 X420 在所有其他计算机中脱颖而出？

segments.en: All right, so this is a verbal phrase to stand out.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以这是一个表示脱颖而出的动词短语。

segments.en: It's very similar to the one that we just mentioned to differentiate.
segments.zh: 它和我们刚刚提到的 differentiate 非常相似。

segments.en: This means what makes this computer special?
segments.zh: 这意味着是什么让这台计算机与众不同？

segments.en: Why is it unique?
segments.zh: 为什么它是独一无二的？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So we're basically saying, why is this one more noticeable than the rest?
segments.zh: 所以我们基本上是在说，为什么这一种比其他的更明显？

segments.en: That's to stand out.
segments.zh: 这就是 stand out 的意思。

segments.en: So maybe if everyone in the office is wearing white t-shirts today, but somebody comes in wearing a red t-shirt, that person is going to stand out.
segments.zh: 所以也许如果办公室里的每个人今天都穿着白色 T 恤，但有人穿着红色 T 恤进来，那个人会脱颖而出。

segments.en: Actually, Marco, I think today that's you.
segments.zh: 实际上，马可，我想今天就是你。

segments.en: You're wearing a red t-shirt today, so you stand out.
segments.zh: 你今天穿着红色T恤，所以你脱颖而出。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So now as he continued to talk about the computer, he used this prefix before an adjective.
segments.zh: 所以现在他继续谈论计算机，他在形容词之前使用了这个前缀。

segments.en: That was very interesting.
segments.zh: 那很有趣。

segments.en: He said, this computer is ultra light.
segments.zh: 他说，这台电脑是超轻的。

segments.en: And then he said it's ultra thin as well.
segments.zh: 然后他说它也很薄。

segments.en: And that it has an ultra fast processor.
segments.zh: 而且它有一个超快速的处理器。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So ultra light, ultra fast, ultra thin.
segments.zh: 如此超轻、超快、超薄。

segments.en: This is a way of saying very, very.
segments.zh: 这是一种非常非常的说法。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So that's what he's saying.
segments.zh: 所以他就是这么说的。

segments.en: He's saying it's very light, it's very thin.
segments.zh: 他说它很轻，很薄。

segments.en: So that's pretty much the structure.
segments.zh: 所以结构差不多就是这样。

segments.en: You can add ultra before an adjective to emphasize that it's very something.
segments.zh: 你可以在形容词前加上 ultra，用来强调某样东西非常非常……

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So when I think of cool actors, I think of James Dean.
segments.zh: 所以当我想到酷演员时，我会想到詹姆斯·迪恩。

segments.en: He was ultra cool.
segments.zh: 他超级酷。

segments.en: Ultra cool.
segments.zh: 超酷。

segments.en: Very cool.
segments.zh: 真酷。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So you can do it with pretty much all adjectives, but you can't really exaggerate and use it all the time.
segments.zh: 所以你几乎可以用所有的形容词来做到这一点，但你不能一直夸大和使用它。

segments.en: Well, the key is to remember this is an exaggeration.
segments.zh: 好吧，关键是要记住这是夸大其词。

segments.en: So yeah, you don't want to use it all the time.
segments.zh: 所以，是的，你不想一直使用它。

segments.en: But if you want to make sure you say that something is, if you want to emphasize that something is special or that it's very, very something, you use the word ultra.
segments.zh: 但如果你想强调某样东西很特别，或者它非常非常……你就用 ultra 这个词。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: As you continue to talk about the characteristics of the laptop computer, he made reference to the LCD display, the screen of the computer.
segments.zh: 他继续谈到这台笔记本电脑的特点时，提到了液晶显示屏，也就是电脑的屏幕。

segments.en: And he said that it's a crystal clear 15 inch LCD display.
segments.zh: 他说这是一个晶莹剔透的15英寸液晶显示器。

segments.en: What does he mean by crystal clear?
segments.zh: 他所说的晶莹剔透是什么意思？

segments.en: Well, crystal is a very special kind of glass, right?
segments.zh: 嗯，水晶是一种非常特殊的玻璃，对吧？

segments.en: And so it's expensive.
segments.zh: 所以它很贵。

segments.en: It's what some people have as their special glassware, you know, wine glasses and drinking glasses.
segments.zh: 这是一些人拥有的特殊玻璃器皿，你知道的，酒杯和水杯。

segments.en: And so crystal is very special because it's so clear to see through.
segments.zh: 所以水晶非常特别，因为它非常通透。

segments.en: So transparent.
segments.zh: 如此透明。

segments.en: It's transparent.
segments.zh: 它是透明的。

segments.en: Light goes through it.
segments.zh: 光穿过它。

segments.en: You can see everything.
segments.zh: 你可以看到一切。

segments.en: And so to say something is crystal clear is to say that it's very, very clear.
segments.zh: 所以说某事非常清楚就是说它非常非常清楚。

segments.en: It's extremely clear.
segments.zh: 它非常清晰。

segments.en: It's as clear as crystal.
segments.zh: 它像水晶一样清晰。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So basically the screen of this computer, you can see very, very well everything that's on the screen, everything that's happening.
segments.zh: 所以基本上这台电脑的屏幕，你可以看到屏幕上的一切，正在发生的一切。

segments.en: All the colors, all of the words.
segments.zh: 所有的颜色，所有的单词。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And then moving away from the characteristics of the computer, he talked about projected sales and he expected $20 million.
segments.zh: 然后，说完电脑的特性之后，他谈到了预计销售额，他预计能达到 2000 万美元。

segments.en: But he said that that is a very conservative estimate.
segments.zh: 但他说这是一个非常保守的估计。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So an estimate is like a guess.
segments.zh: 所以估计就像一个猜测。

segments.en: It's how much we think we will earn in a year or how much we think will happen.
segments.zh: 这是我们认为我们将在一年内赚多少钱，或者我们认为会发生多少。

segments.en: But in this case, a conservative estimate means that it's a low estimate.
segments.zh: 但在这种情况下，保守估计意味着它是一个低估计。

segments.en: You know, we might make $20 million next year.
segments.zh: 你知道，我们明年可能会赚到 2000 万美元。

segments.en: That's conservative.
segments.zh: 那是保守的。

segments.en: Another estimate is we will make $40 million.
segments.zh: 另一个估计是我们将赚取 4000 万美元。

segments.en: So that's not conservative.
segments.zh: 所以这不是保守的。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So as you said, an estimate is we are more or less guessing how much it would be.
segments.zh: 正如你所说，我们或多或少地猜测它会是多少。

segments.en: So what would be the opposite of a conservative estimate?
segments.zh: 那么保守估计的反义词是什么？

segments.en: You could say a generous estimate.
segments.zh: 你可以说一个慷慨的估计。

segments.en: That means you're giving a lot.
segments.zh: 这意味着你给出的数字很大。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So a generous estimate is our revenues will be at around $60 million next year.
segments.zh: 所以一个慷慨的估计是我们明年的收入将约为 6000 万美元。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So I think we've taken in a lot.
segments.zh: 所以我想我们已经吸收了很多。

segments.en: Why don't we take a break?
segments.zh: 我们为什么不休息一下？

segments.en: Let's listen to the dialogue again and we'll be back with Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 让我们再次聆听对话，我们将带着流利表达回来。

segments.zh: 现在您可能会问自己的一个关键问题是，新的 X420 系列与我们以前的型号有何不同？

segments.en: And also, of course, with some of our competitors.

segments.zh: 这是一个关键问题，也是我想深入探讨的问题。

segments.zh: 首先，X420 有一系列 USPS，真正使它比其他产品更胜一筹。

segments.en: The first thing to mention is that the X420 is the first in a new generation of ultra-light laptop computers.

segments.en: It is only two pounds, which compares very favorably with all our key competitors.

segments.zh: 在计算机性能方面，对于这样一台轻型机器来说，它是非常强大的。

segments.en: Four gigabytes of RAM with an ultra-fast processor.
segments.zh: 4 GB RAM 超快处理器。

segments.zh: 它配备了市场上最先进的显卡和声卡，以及一块清晰通透的 15 英寸液晶显示屏。

segments.zh: X420作为下一代笔记本电脑确实脱颖而出。

segments.zh: 现在这确实是一个保守的估计。

segments.zh: 如果我们的营销活动成功，我相信我们至少可以看到这个数字的两倍。

segments.en: Now please bear in mind that this is only for the first year of production.
segments.zh: 现在请记住，这只是生产的第一年。

segments.en: I'm certain that in the coming three years, the X420 will actually overtake all our existing products, both in terms of sales and revenue.
segments.zh: 我敢肯定，在未来三年中，X420 实际上将在销售和收入方面超过我们所有现有产品。

segments.zh: 好的，现在让我们继续讨论我们的营销理念，更仔细地看看我们的主要竞争对手。

segments.zh: 好吧，我们带着流利表达回来了。

segments.en: Let's take a look at some key phrases now.
segments.zh: 现在让我们来看看一些关键短语。

segments.en: Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 流利表达。

segments.en: Alright, so our first phrase is a very important phrase when you're trying to differentiate different products or things.
segments.zh: 好吧，当您尝试区分不同的产品或事物时，我们的第一个短语是一个非常重要的短语。

segments.en: We say, this is really a cut above the rest.
segments.zh: 我们说，这确实比别人高出一筹。

segments.en: Okay, so if something is a cut above the rest, it means that it's in a different category from everyone else.
segments.zh: 好的，所以如果某样东西比别人高出一筹，这意味着它与其他东西属于不同的类别。

segments.en: It's a lot better.
segments.zh: 它好多了。

segments.en: It is a lot better.
segments.zh: 它好很多。

segments.en: So you can say that we saw many, many applicants who wanted to come for a job at our company, but John, he was a cut above the rest.
segments.zh: 所以你可以说我们看到很多很多申请人想来我们公司工作，但约翰，他比其他人高出一筹。

segments.en: He was much better than all of the other candidates.
segments.zh: 他比所有其他候选人都好得多。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: So a cut above the rest.
segments.zh: 所以就是比别人高出一筹。

segments.en: Now when we talked about this computer, he also made reference saying that it's in a league of its own.
segments.zh: 现在当我们谈到这台电脑时，他还提到它独树一帜。

segments.en: The computer is so powerful, it's so new, it's so fantastic that it's in a league of its own.
segments.zh: 这台电脑如此强大、如此新、如此出色，以至于它自成一档。

segments.en: Okay, so a league is like a category in this case.
segments.zh: 好吧，在这种情况下，league 就像是一个类别。

segments.en: We have good computers and we have great computers, but this computer is so good.
segments.zh: 我们有好的电脑，也有很棒的电脑，但这台电脑实在太好了。

segments.en: It's in an entirely new category.
segments.zh: 它属于一个全新的类别。

segments.en: It's awesome.
segments.zh: 太棒了。

segments.en: It's amazing.
segments.zh: 太神奇了。

segments.en: It's mind blowing.
segments.zh: 它令人震撼。

segments.en: So we often say this with new things.
segments.zh: 所以我们常用这个说法来形容新事物。

segments.en: This is great, but nothing before it can compare.
segments.zh: 它很棒，此前没有任何东西能与之相比。

segments.en: They're just not as good.
segments.zh: 它们只是没有那么好。

segments.en: So it's in a league of its own.
segments.zh: 所以它自成一档。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: So you can make reference to products or also people, right?
segments.zh: 所以你可以用它来指产品，也可以指人，对吧？

segments.en: A person can be in a league of his own.
segments.zh: 一个人也可以自成一档。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So you know, there are a lot of good singers in the world, but this singer, he is in a league of his own.
segments.zh: 所以你知道，世界上有很多优秀的歌手，但这位歌手却独树一帜。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: And to finish off Fluency Builder, towards the end of his dialogue, he said, to please bear in mind that this is only the first year of production.
segments.zh: 在流利表达的最后，在对话接近尾声时，他说，请记住，这只是生产的第一年。

segments.en: Okay, so we're talking about making these products.
segments.zh: 好的，所以我们正在谈论制作这些产品。

segments.en: You know, there's going to take time to make money and Mr. Ford would like us to bear something in mind, to bear in mind this fact.
segments.zh: 你知道，需要时间来赚钱，福特先生希望我们牢记一些事情，记住这个事实。

segments.en: So to bear something in mind means to remember or to consider.
segments.zh: 所以牢记某事意味着记住或考虑。

segments.en: Okay, so he's asking us to please consider that it's only the first year of production, so we can't really expect too much.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以他要求我们考虑一下这只是生产的第一年，所以我们不能真的期望太多。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So I could talk about a number of different things.
segments.zh: 所以我可以谈谈一些不同的事情。

segments.en: I could say, you know, Marco, here's my report.
segments.zh: 我可以说，你知道，马可，这是我的报告。

segments.en: Please look over it.
segments.zh: 请看一下。

segments.en: Please bear in mind, this is only a first draft.
segments.zh: 请记住，这只是初稿。

segments.en: Okay, so I will make some edits, I will make some changes.
segments.zh: 好的，所以我会做一些编辑，我会做一些改变。

segments.en: It's not perfect and I know that.
segments.zh: 它并不完美，我知道这一点。

segments.en: So please bear this in mind.
segments.zh: 所以请记住这一点。

segments.en: Okay, so you're kind of warning me, you're kind of letting me know to consider the fact that it's not the final report and there might be some mistakes.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以你有点警告我，你有点让我知道这不是最终报告，可能会有一些错误。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So to bear in mind that saying this is kind of like a warning that things are not perfect yet but, you know, I still want your opinion.
segments.zh: 所以请记住，说这有点像警告，事情还不完美，但是，你知道，我仍然想要你的意见。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: So why don't we listen to the dialogue again and we'll be back in a bit.
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不再听一次对话，我们会回来的。

segments.en: Now a key question you might ask yourself is what differentiates the new X420 line with our previous models and also of course with some of our competitors.
segments.zh: 现在，您可能会问自己的一个关键问题是，新 X420 系列与我们以前的型号以及与一些竞争对手相比有何不同。

segments.en: In other words, what makes the X420 stand out from all the others?
segments.zh: 换句话说，是什么让 X420 脱颖而出？

segments.en: This is a key question and it's something I'd like to explore in a little depth.
segments.zh: 这是一个关键问题，也是我想深入探讨的问题。

segments.en: Firstly, the X420 has a range of USPs that really make it a cut above the rest.
segments.zh: 首先，X420 有一系列 USPS，真正使它比其他产品更胜一筹。

segments.en: The first thing to mention is that the X420 is the first in a new generation of ultra-light laptop computers.
segments.zh: 首先要提到的是，X420是新一代超轻型笔记本电脑中的第一款。

segments.en: It is only 2 pounds which compares very favorably with all our key competitors.
segments.zh: 与我们所有的主要竞争对手相比，它只有 2 磅。

segments.en: In terms of computer performance, for such a light machine, it's very powerful.
segments.zh: 在计算机性能方面，对于这样一台轻型机器来说，它是非常强大的。

segments.en: 4 gigabytes of RAM with an ultra-fast processor, the most advanced video and sound cards on the market are installed with a crystal clear 15-inch LCD display.
segments.zh: 4 GB 的 RAM 配备超快处理器，市场上最先进的视频和声卡安装了清晰的 15 英寸 LCD 显示屏。

segments.en: The X420 really stands out as a next generation laptop.
segments.zh: X420作为下一代笔记本电脑确实脱颖而出。

segments.en: Compared with our previous X540 range, it really is in a league of its own.
segments.zh: 与我们之前的 X540 系列相比，它确实独树一帜。

segments.en: Now if we go on to look at projected sales for the X420, we can see that sales revenue for 2010 is expected to hit at least $20 million.
segments.zh: 现在，如果我们继续查看 X420 的预计销售额，我们可以看到 2010 年的销售收入预计将达到至少 2000 万美元。

segments.en: Now this is really a conservative estimate.
segments.zh: 现在这确实是一个保守的估计。

segments.en: If our marketing campaign is successful, I'm confident that we could see a doubling of this figure at the very least.
segments.zh: 如果我们的营销活动成功，我相信我们至少可以看到这个数字的两倍。

segments.en: Now please bear in mind that this is only for the first year of production.
segments.zh: 现在请记住，这只是生产的第一年。

segments.en: I'm certain that in the coming 3 years, the X420 will actually overtake all our existing products, both in terms of sales and revenue.
segments.zh: 我敢肯定，在未来 3 年中，X420 实际上将在销售和收入方面超过我们所有现有产品。

segments.en: Ok, now let's move on to discuss our marketing concept and look more closely at our key competitors.
segments.zh: 好的，现在让我们继续讨论我们的营销理念，更仔细地看看我们的主要竞争对手。

segments.en: We're back.
segments.zh: 我们回来了。

segments.en: Now you've probably saw this acronym in the very first part of the dialogue when he said that the X420 has a range of USPs that really make it a cut above the rest.
segments.zh: 现在你可能已经在对话的第一部分看到了这个首字母缩略词，当时他说 X420 有一系列 USPS，这确实使它比其他人更上一层楼。

segments.en: Alright, so this is a very special acronym for the business world and it stands for U – Unique, S – Selling, and P – Point.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以这是商业世界里一个很特别的缩写词，它代表 U – Unique、S – Selling 和 P – Point。

segments.en: Unique Selling Point.
segments.zh: 独特的卖点。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So as the name says, a unique selling point are characteristics that are unique to the machine that allow it to be more competitive and to persuade people to buy it or to sell itself.
segments.zh: 顾名思义，一个独特的卖点是机器独有的特征，可以让它更具竞争力并说服人们购买或推销自己。

segments.en: So the new iPhone has a very interesting unique selling point.
segments.zh: 所以新iPhone有一个非常有趣的独特卖点。

segments.en: It has two cameras, one on the front and one on the back.
segments.zh: 它有两个摄像头，一台在前面，一台在后面。

segments.en: So that really differentiates it from other phones on the market.
segments.zh: 因此，这确实将其与市场上的其他手机区分开来。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So that is what a USP is or a unique selling point.
segments.zh: 这就是 USP 或独特的卖点。

segments.en: As we said, it's an acronym in the business world, but next time that you find the opportunity to use it, I'm sure it's going to sound amazing.
segments.zh: 正如我们所说，它是商业世界的首字母缩写词，但下次你有机会使用它时，我相信它会听起来很棒。

segments.en: Yes, very professional.
segments.zh: 是的，非常专业。

segments.en: USP, Unique Selling Point.
segments.zh: USP，独特的卖点。

segments.en: Alright so that's all the time we have.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们的时间就到这里了。

segments.en: Be sure to check out the next part of our series next week and of course if you have any questions or comments, you're always welcome at EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 请务必在下周查看我们系列的下一部分，当然，如果您有任何问题或意见，我们随时欢迎您访问 Englishpod.com。

segments.en: We will see you there.
segments.zh: 我们会在那里见到你。

segments.en: Bye guys.
segments.zh: 大家再见。

segments.en: Enjoy your day.
segments.zh: 祝你今天愉快。
